intro.title: Hi, I'm Laura
intro.paragraph:
I'm a graphic designer passionate about creating visual identities, branding, and print design. I love turning ideas into clear, creative visuals that tell a story.

Through my portfolio, I'm excited to share a selection of projects that reflect my process, creativity, and love for design.
intro.branding.title: Branding
intro.branding.body: My work in branding focuses on creating visual identities that reflect personality and purpose. I aim to build designs that feel cohesive, and timeless. Translating concepts into strong, recognizable visuals.
intro.print.title: Print design
intro.print.body: I explore how typography, layout, and imagery can bring content to life. From books and posters to newspapers, I combine structure with storytelling to create meaningful visual experiences.
projects.title: My Projects
projects.twiin.title: Twiin - sneakers
projects.twiin.intro: Twiin is a conceptual sneaker brand built around the idea of duality and individuality. Each pair combines one dynamic, colourful shoe with one calm, neutral counterpart, a visual expression of the belief that people shouldn't be placed into boxes.
projects.twiin.body:
By embracing contrast, Twiin creates space for everyone to express their own identity, in their own way.

This school project includes a one-page website, Instagram posts, and campaign material, all designed to reinforce the brand's message of freedom, inclusivity, and creative self-expression.
projects.the-models-guide.title: The Model's Guide. - Cookbook
projects.the-models-guide.body:
The Model's Guide is a conceptual cookbook that humorously plays with the stereotype of models and minimal eating. With a clean, minimal layout and images generated through Adobe Firefly, the design emphasizes the satirical tone of the project.

Created as a school assignment, it explores simplicity, contrast, and concept-driven editorial design.
projects.crosby-stills-nash.title: Crosby, Stills & Nash - LP-cover
projects.crosby-stills-nash.intro: For this LP cover, I created a design inspired by the theme of connection found in the album's lyrics. I used an old mobile phone as the central visual element — a symbol of communication, nostalgia, and the way we stay linked to others.
projects.crosby-stills-nash.body: This project explores how a simple object can carry emotional meaning and strengthen the visual identity of the music.
projects.clb-kies.title: CLB Kies! - Graduation project
projects.clb-kies.intro:
For my graduation project, I collaborated with a multidisciplinary team to develop SAM, a digital platform created for the Centrum voor Leerlingenbegeleiding (CLB). The platform supports 5th- and 6th-grade students and their parents as they navigate the important transition from primary to secondary education.
https://sam.clbwestvlaanderen.be/
projects.clb-kies.within: Within the team, I focused on branding and the creation of animated explainer videos, helping shape a visual identity that feels friendly, accessible, and clear for young users. We designed bite-sized information pages, six animations, and a full set of campaign materials, including posters, stickers, and a recognisable mascot.
projects.clb-kies.award: Our project was showcased at the Artevelde University College expo, where it received the Student Award for Best Studio Project, a rewarding recognition of our teamwork and user-centered approach.
projects.clb-kies.body: This project strengthened my skills in collaboration, visual communication, and designing with impact, and it was an honour to contribute to a tool that genuinely supports children and their families.
projects.regenkreet.title: Regenkreet - Poster
projects.regenkreet.body:
For this poster, I created a visual interpretation of a poem by translating its emotion into expressive colour and texture. I worked with Ecoline to capture the poem's atmosphere in a fluid, organic way, allowing the paint to reflect the softness, intensity, and movement found in the text.

The result is a poster where typography and illustration merge into one emotional, poetic composition.
projects.jazz-in-t-park.title: Jazz in 't park - Music festival
projects.jazz-in-t-park.intro: For this school project, I developed a full rebranding for a music festival aimed at audiences of all ages. I chose a playful and inclusive design style, using vibrant colours, dynamic shapes, and approachable typography to reflect the festival's energetic and welcoming atmosphere.
projects.jazz-in-t-park.body: The rebranding includes posters, Instagram visuals, merchandising, and an informational folder, all designed to create a coherent and engaging visual identity that brings the festival's spirit to life.
projects.omleegvallers-gazet.title: Omleegvallers gazet - Newspaper
projects.omleegvallers-gazet.body:
For this school assignment, I designed a village newspaper that focuses on clear communication, structure, and readability. I combined thoughtful typography with a clean, accessible layout to create a publication that feels both friendly and informative.

This project allowed me to explore editorial design in depth, balancing visual hierarchy, storytelling, and a community-oriented tone.
projects.tarot.title: Tarot card deck
projects.tarot.intro: This tarot card deck reimagines traditional symbolism through a fresh and modern visual approach. Each card combines expressive illustrations with graphic elements, offering a new perspective on familiar archetypes while keeping the essence of the tarot intact.
projects.tarot.body: The project explores storytelling, symbolism, and the interplay between intuition and design, resulting in a deck that is both visually striking and conceptually thoughtful.
about.title: About Me
about.bio:
Hi, I'm Laura Volkaert, a graphic designer with a passion for thoughtful design and visual communication.

After graduating in Graphic and Digital Media, I'm currently expanding my skills in SME Management to deepen my understanding of the business side of creativity.
Throughout my studies, I've worked on a wide range of projects from a rebranding for a jazz festival to editorial and print designs such as cookbooks, newspapers, and posters. These experiences have strengthened my eye for detail, my understanding of print processes, and my ability to translate ideas into clear, expressive visuals.

I value curiosity, passion, and integrity, qualities that drive me to keep learning, experiment with new tools, and deliver work that's both precise and creative. When I'm not designing, you'll probably find me on the volleyball court or behind my camera, exploring new perspectives through photography.
